title: Searching with begin and end
hints: For `lowerBound`, keep the answer inside `[begin, end)`. Look at the middle: if it is smaller than `wanted`, the answer is after it, so move `begin` to `middle + 1`; otherwise the answer is the middle or before it, so move `end` to `middle`.
Compute the middle as `begin + (end - begin) / 2`. You cannot add two pointers, but you can add a count to one.
